name: NG exhaustion higher-order chain study contract
purpose: Measure how far predictive dependence propagates from one exhaustion episode through second-, third-, and higher-order event/tape behavior, and distinguish inherited chains from behavioral resets.

observation_stream.origin: first actual NG trade after the Sunday weekly reopen
observation_stream.end: last actual NG trade before the genuine weekly close
observation_stream.holiday_special_sessions: follow actual trade stream, never assumed clock time

event_detection.signal: trailing-20-second aggressor-volume imbalance from MBP-10 trade price versus concurrent top-of-book midpoint
event_detection.orientation: event polarity from roll20 sign at t0
event_detection.threshold: 85th percentile of absolute roll20 within each UTC source date, preserving the existing NG event-detector threshold convention
event_detection.prominence: absolute t0 roll20 minus median absolute roll20 over t0-30..t0-10
event_detection.week_continuity_extension: candidate windows, prominence history, roll20, and refractory selection may cross UTC-date boundaries; day-native thresholding does not create a chain reset
event_detection.target_day_equivalence: compare continuous-week detected target-day events against the frozen 3429-event reveal+holdout roster and fail closed on unexplained interior mismatches

node_features.a_post_state: frozen A +60 classifier only when family A
node_features.dynamic_endpoint: three consecutive causal forward-filled oriented roll20 <= 0; record structural onset and causal confirmation

fields: seconds and hours since first Sunday-reopen trade
time_context.analysis_role: context/covariate after chain types are discovered

chain_representation.structural_sequence: all detected exhaustion events ordered continuously inside the trading week
chain_representation.state_sequence: validated seed aftermath state per event
chain_representation.overlap: record whether a descendant event starts before the ancestor exhaustion endpoint confirms
chain_representation.executable_link: record whether the predecessor state used for a prediction was causally known before the descendant t0

chain_questions: Does current event state predict event n+1?
Does adding event n-1 improve prediction of n+1 beyond current event alone?
Does adding n-2 improve again, and how far does incremental information survive?
Which polarity/state sequences form reproducible long chains versus short chains?
At what link does inherited information from the chain origin cease to improve prediction over a fresh first-order model?
Do post-end tape continuation/reversal outcomes themselves propagate into later exhaustion states?
Do specific chain types cluster by time-of-day/session position without using time as a gate?

order_depth.stop_rule: continue increasing event-order depth while out-of-sample predictive improvement and sample support survive; stop/downgrade when incremental information disappears or sample size becomes uninformative
order_depth.combinatorial_guardrail: do not promote rare exact sequences solely because they were screened; prefer state aggregation, shrinkage, monotone effects, and leave-one-week-out replication

validation.initial_method: leave-one-trading-week-out replication for chain-order models and sequence statistics
validation.higher_order_promotion: requires replication beyond one week and eventual forward-live validation

parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.order_memory: Markov/event-order incremental prediction and polarity/state sequence depth
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.tape_propagation: post-end continuation/reversal propagation through later events
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.reset_detection: test when origin information no longer adds beyond current state
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.time_context: describe timing/session clustering after chain types are identified
